messages:
marco: Quick poll: one song that nails a movie scene + one line from a book that still echoes. single picks, no explanations. go!
jess: Song: 'Air — La femme d'argent' for the Tokyo hotel night scene in Lost in Translation. Book line: 'We accept the love we think we deserve.' :heart:
omar: Song: 'Clint Mansell — Lux Aeterna' for the Requiem for a Dream montage. Book line: 'Definitions belong to the definers, not the defined.'
sophia: Song: 'Billie Holiday — Strange Fruit' for an opening that jumps straight into doom. Book line: 'I am haunted by humans.'
liam: Song: 'M83 — Outro' for any triumphant-but-quiet finale. Book line: 'It is only with the heart that one can see rightly.'
karen: Song: 'Rachel Portman — Cider House Rules theme' (soft, bittersweet). Book line: 'Memories are the only things that are real.'
mina: Song: 'Portishead — Roads' for rainy slow-mo walking shots. Book line: 'Maybe the journey isn't about becoming anything.'
giphy-bot: *posts gif of someone dramatically handing over headphones* :headphones: :laughing:
omar: also adding :fire: to jess and liam picks
sophia: OK I need to queue all of these for my next weekend :joy:
marco: perfect. bookmarking these. next time: theme = one absurd soundtrack-for-an-unlikely-movie pairing? :eyes:
